entries.title: Psalms 35:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Plead [my cause], O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

entries.title: Psalms 35:2
segments: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.

entries.title: Psalms 35:3
segments: Draw out also the spear, and stop [the way] against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I [am] thy salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 35:4
segments: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

entries.title: Psalms 35:5
segments: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase [them].

entries.title: Psalms 35:6
segments: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them. {dark...: Heb. darkness and slipperiness}

entries.title: Psalms 35:7
segments: For without cause have they hid for me their net [in] a pit, [which] without cause they have digged for my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 35:8
segments: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall. {at...: Heb. which he knoweth not of}

words.text: . {at...: Heb. which he knoweth not of}

entries.title: Psalms 35:9
segments: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 35:10
segments: All my bones shall say, LORD, who [is] like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

words.text: , who [is] like unto thee, which deliverest
from him that is too strong

entries.title: Psalms 35:11
segments: ¶False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge [things] that I knew not. {False...: Heb. Witnesses of wrong} {they...: Heb. they asked me}

words.text: not. {False...: Heb. Witnesses of wrong} {they...: Heb. they asked me}

entries.title: Psalms 35:12
segments: They rewarded me evil for good [to] the spoiling of my soul. {spoiling: Heb. depriving}

entries.title: Psalms 35:13
segments: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing [was] sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom. {humbled: or, afflicted}

words.text: But as for me, when they were sick

entries.title: Psalms 35:14
segments: I behaved myself as though [he had been] my friend [or] brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth [for his] mother. {behaved myself: Heb. walked} {as though...: Heb. as a friend, as a brother to me}

words.text: myself as though [he had been] my friend
. {behaved myself: Heb. walked} {as though...: Heb. as a friend, as a brother to me}

entries.title: Psalms 35:15
segments: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: [yea], the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew [it] not; they did tear [me], and ceased not: {adversity: Heb. halting}

entries.title: Psalms 35:16
segments: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

entries.title: Psalms 35:17
segments: ¶Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions. {darling: Heb. only one}

words.text: , how long wilt thou look on

entries.title: Psalms 35:18
segments: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people. {much: Heb. strong}

entries.title: Psalms 35:19
segments: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: [neither] let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause. {wrongfully: Heb. falsely}

words.text: Let not them that are mine enemies

entries.title: Psalms 35:20
segments: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against [them that are] quiet in the land.

entries.title: Psalms 35:21
segments: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, [and] said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen [it].

entries.title: Psalms 35:22
segments: [This] thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

entries.title: Psalms 35:23
segments: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, [even] unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 35:24
segments: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

entries.title: Psalms 35:25
segments: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up. {Ah...: Heb. Ah, ah, our soul}

entries.title: Psalms 35:26
segments: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify [themselves] against me.

entries.title: Psalms 35:27
segments: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant. {righteous...: Heb. righteousness}

entries.title: Psalms 35:28
segments: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness [and] of thy praise all the day long.
